# Plexi

> Plexi is a tiling terminal for vibecoding: an agent cockpit with terminal sessions and local apps in one workspace.

Run your terminal-based coding agents beside shells, notes, and small tools. Plexi provides panes, project contexts, agent status hooks, and a CLI for controlling the host. Agents use their own provider accounts or API keys; Plexi does not supply a model subscription. Local apps can be built with the Python SDK.

Install on macOS using the command from the download page:

```sh
curl -fsSL https://plexiapp.com/install | bash
```

See the download page for current platform availability and release guidance.

## Start here

- [Download](https://plexiapp.com/download): Install command and release guidance.
- [Getting started](https://plexiapp.com/docs/getting-started): Installation, first session, and channels.
